parts.text: Draft an Agent Memory Protocol document at docs/agent-memory-protocol.md. Define three tiers: short-term (session context), medium-term (MEMORY.md + recent logs), long-term (memories/ archive). Specify the file format, naming conventions, and when each tier gets consulted. Reference the existing MEMORY.md and memory/ patterns already in use.

Context:
This is a docs task only. Code should create the document, not build infrastructure.
